## Fluid Relay  
  
<!--a5e8a0f8-2c84-407a-b3d8-f371d684363b_begin-->

#### Upgrade your Azure Fluid Relay client library  
  
If you invoke the Azure Fluid Relay service by using an old client library, it might cause application problems. To keep your application running, upgrade your Azure Fluid Relay client library to the latest version. Upgrading gives you the most up-to-date functionality, and improvements in performance and stability.
  
**Potential benefits**: Improved reliability  

**Impact:** Medium
  
For more information, see [Version compatibility with Fluid Framework releases - Azure Fluid Relay ](/azure/azure-fluid-relay/concepts/version-compatibility)  

ResourceType: microsoft.fluidrelay/fluidrelayservers  
Recommendation ID: a5e8a0f8-2c84-407a-b3d8-f371d684363b  
Subcategory: ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement

<!--a5e8a0f8-2c84-407a-b3d8-f371d684363b_end-->

<!--12917c27-d8fe-4db3-8292-8e7a768470ac_begin-->

#### Migrate from Azure Fluid Relay endpoints and APIs to recommended replacement solution  
  
Azure Fluid Relay is retiring, and Azure Fluid Relay endpoints and APIs won't be available. Migrate existing Azure Fluid Relay workloads to the recommended replacement solution.  
  
**Potential benefits**: Avoid potential disruptions  

**Impact:** High
  
For more information, see [Fluid Framework self-host tools](https://github.com/microsoft/FluidFramework/tree/main/tools/selfhost)  

ResourceType: microsoft.fluidrelay/fluidrelayservers  
Recommendation ID: 12917c27-d8fe-4db3-8292-8e7a768470ac
